description: Change the reverse DNS entry for one of a load balancer's public IP addresses. Set dns_ptr to null to reset to the default.

dns_ptr.description: Reverse DNS PTR record value, or null to reset to the default

ip.description: Public IPv4 or IPv6 address of the load balancer to set the reverse DNS entry for

name: hetzner_change_lb_dns_ptr
title: Change Load Balancer Reverse DNS
